description: Wait for a job that returned status working with a job_id (from council_ask, council_debate, council_ask_codex, council_ask_claude or council_join), and return its answer, or with council_join your next turn. Waits up to about 50 s and returns as soon as something is ready; if the job is still working, call it again. Use it instead of asking the same question again, which would start a second job and use the plans twice. Waiting uses no model quota.

job_id.description: The job_id a council tool returned while still working. Omit to use the most recent job.

name: council_result

council_id.description: With your_turn: the council to reply to with council_turn.

job_id.description: With working or stopped: the job to wait for, or the one stopped.

status.description: done: text is the answer. working: still running; call council_result with job_id. your_turn (council_join): text is the council's message; reply with council_turn and council_id. stopped: council_cancel stopped job_id.

text.description: The answer (council_debate: its JSON), or the message to act on; the same as the text content.

title: Get a running council's answer
